failure: A new production note had no native embedding or queued embedding job after an otherwise complete index activation.
root_causes: Note creation did not queue indexing.
Note content/title edits invalidated embeddings without queuing replacements.
Unchanged submitted text unnecessarily invalidated retained-profile vectors.
acceptance: Note creation and its indexing job commit in one transaction.
Changed embedding source fields queue a replacement in the source-save transaction.
Metadata and identical source fields retain current vectors.
Queue failure rolls back the source save and invalidation instead of reporting success.
Concurrent edits deduplicate pending work; deletion cannot resurrect the source.
A current-source coverage readback must use fresh targets, not a fixed earlier row count.
